name: github-feedback-chrome
description: Comment on a running page and file it as a GitHub Issue with screenshot and context (Chrome extension)

scripts.check: node -e "for (const f of require('fs').readdirSync('src').filter((f) => f.endsWith('.js'))) require('child_process').execFileSync(process.execPath, ['--check', 'src/' + f], { stdio: 'inherit' })"
scripts.verify: npm run check && npm test && node scripts/verify-manifest.js
